USER EXPERIENCE (UX) & CONVERSION AUDIT REPORT
Website: https://gadigitalsolutions.com
Target Platform: Desktop & Mobile Viewports (320px - 1440px)
Audit Date: October 7, 2026
Focus Areas: UX Journey, Mobile Responsiveness, Form CRO, Information Architecture & Visual Hierarchy
Prepared for: GA Digital Solutions Team
1. Executive UX Summary & Customer Journey

A comprehensive visual and interaction audit was conducted on https://gadigitalsolutions.com across Desktop (1440px) and Mobile (325px - 414px) devices. The site presents a clean modern theme, but suffers from critical user experience bottlenecks in mobile navigation, unquantified portfolio social proof, and high-friction contact forms.

Prospective Customer Journey Breakdown

Stage User Expectation Current Reality UX Friction Level
1. Landing Hero Clear value proposition & why to choose GADS Generic title & decorative background. Lacks social proof badges. Medium
2. Service Discovery Quickly find specific service details Unstructured service lists; mobile dropdown menu collapses easily. High
3. Proof & Trust Proof of past performance & ROI Portfolio shows thumbnails without metric badges (+200% ROI, etc.). Critical
4. Conversion Fast, low-friction quote request Forms use generic "Submit" button and lack instant validation. High

Figure 1.2: Mobile Viewport (375px). Header takes 20% fold height; headline wraps heavily.
3. Mobile Navigation & Usability Audit

Mobile users represent over 65% of incoming traffic. The navigation bar on mobile viewports currently presents friction points that prevent smooth service discovery.

Figure 2.1: Mobile Navigation Menu state. Sub-links require precise touch accuracy.
Figure 2.2: Mobile Contact Form UX. Sticky bar at bottom risks overlapping form inputs.

Mobile UX Key Findings & Remedies

  • Small Touch Targets: Several navigation sub-items and social icons in the footer measure under 36px in height. Fix: Increase padding to ensure a minimum 48px x 48px tap area.
  • Horizontal Table Overflow: Data tables on blog and service pages overflow screen boundaries on 320px - 375px screens. Fix: Apply overflow-x: auto container wrappers.
  • Sticky Bar Overlap: The sticky bottom call/WhatsApp bar overlaps submit buttons on short mobile screens. Fix: Add padding-bottom: 70px to mobile containers.
4. Service Discovery & Portfolio Proof
Figure 3.1: Service Landing Page Layout. Copy is structured, but lacks inline pricing tiers or quick jump links.
Figure 3.2: Design Portfolio Grid. Visual thumbnails need quantified case study results (+300% leads).
5. Prioritized UX Action Plan
Priority Location UX Issue Identified Recommended Fix
Critical Mobile Nav Drawer Dropdown links difficult to expand on small screens Convert menu into full-height accordion drawer with 48px touch targets.
Critical Portfolio / Works Thumbnails lack client results / social proof Add metric overlay badges (e.g. "+250% Organic Traffic Growth").
High Contact / Enquiry Forms Generic "Submit" button & missing inline validation Change button text to "Get My Free Strategy Audit" & add live validation.
High Mobile Blog Pages Tables overflow screen boundaries on 375px viewports Wrap tables in overflow-x: auto CSS container.
Medium Mobile Contact Bar Sticky footer bar overlaps bottom form fields Apply padding-bottom: 70px on mobile body layout.
